from datetime import datetime

from threetears.evals import Eval

from eta import estimate, hours_between

def predict(case):
    """How far the estimate was from the delivery scan, in hours."""
    eta = estimate(datetime.fromisoformat(case["booked_at"]), case["origin"], case["destination"])
    return {"miss_h": hours_between(eta, datetime.fromisoformat(case["delivered_at"]))}


def within_three_hours(case, out):
    """The shipment was delivered within three hours of its estimate, as the README promises."""
    return out["miss_h"] <= 3.0 + 1e-9

shipments = Eval("data/delivered.jsonl", runner=predict, grader=[within_three_hours], k=1)
